related_datasets.title: OPERA DSWx-HLS v1
related_datasets.use_case: Recent surface-water extent and change monitoring from optical observations.
related_datasets.temporal_coverage: Validated observations begin April 2023; production is ongoing. The catalog also lists an earlier start date; historical completeness was not checked here.
related_datasets.access: NASA PO.DAAC; Earthdata Login is required for the documented direct S3 data access in us-west-2. Anonymous asset access was not tested.
related_datasets.comparison: Per-observation water classifications and confidence/cloud layers serve a different purpose from JRC 1984–2024 occurrence. Clouds limit optical observations; a long-term occurrence composite would require an explicit method and validation.

evidence.title: NASA PO.DAAC product and access documentation

related_datasets.title: OPERA DSWx-S1 v1
related_datasets.use_case: Recent open-water mapping under cloud cover and at night using Sentinel-1 radar.
related_datasets.temporal_coverage: Forward production began September 2024 and is ongoing; the catalog includes earlier dates. Coverage for a particular region and date remains to be qualified.
related_datasets.access: NASA PO.DAAC distribution; no file-level access or conformance checks performed in this comparison.
related_datasets.comparison: The producer targets open inland water bodies greater than 3 hectares and 200 m in width. It is a recent radar extent product, not JRC historical occurrence; OPERA products are not harmonized across sensors. Use reprocessed replacements for the documented 2025 processing anomaly.

evidence.title: NASA PO.DAAC product documentation and reprocessing notice
JPL DSWx suite and sensor differences
NASA DSWx fact sheet and COG format

related_datasets.title: Dynamic World v1
related_datasets.use_case: Recent water and flooded-vegetation context alongside other land-cover classes.
related_datasets.access: Official Earth Engine image collection. Independent bulk hosting and anonymous cloud-native asset access were not qualified here.
related_datasets.comparison: The water band is a model class probability, not an observed multi-decade water-occurrence percentage. Cloud masking, probability thresholds and temporal aggregation must be specified before deriving a water product.

evidence.title: Official Dynamic World catalog and terms

related_datasets.title: Copernicus Water Bodies 100 m monthly v1
related_datasets.use_case: Regular global monthly inland-water monitoring at coarser resolution.
related_datasets.access: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem lists a COG collection; individual objects, current completeness and access requirements were not tested here.
related_datasets.comparison: Coarser than JRC and uses JRC maximum water extent in its masking, so it is not an independent reference for validating JRC. Its monthly detections and occurrence categories differ from the JRC long-term occurrence statistic.
